start_policy: common first execution at index96, based on index95 close; preceding 96 candles warmup only; fresh flat account
signal_rule: strict sign; exact zero carries previous signal; invalid does not generate orders
end_policy: mark open position at final training close; no synthetic exit or exit fee; pending last-close order unexecuted
model_selection_degrees_of_freedom: two estimator families x five N = ten candidates; method choice is model selection
selection_policy: display all ten and neighborhood comparisons; no automatic winner, ranking score, expanded grid or second search
